# Data Schema

Documentation for all processed data files in this project.

---

## Feature Matrix

**File:** `data/processed/features_daily.parquet`  
**Generated by:** `features/build_features.py`

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Shape | 45,675 rows × 27 columns (25 nodes × 1,827 days) |
| Date range | 2020-01-01 → 2024-12-31 |
| Missing days | Filled with **0.0**, never NaN |

### Columns

| Column | dtype | Description |
|--------|-------|-------------|
| `node_id` | str | City identifier — matches keys in `data/nodes.py` |
| `date` | datetime64 | Calendar date |
| `avg_tone` | float64 | Mean GDELT AvgTone. Higher = more positive media framing. |
| `goldstein` | float64 | Mean GoldsteinScale (−10 to +10). Negative = destabilising. |
| `n_articles` | Int64 | Total article volume — proxy for event salience. |
| `conflict_events` | Int64 | Count of CAMEO codes 18–20 (assault, fighting). |
| `unrest_events` | Int64 | Count of CAMEO codes 14–17 (protest, riots). |
| `n_actors` | float64 | Distinct actor count — proxy for actor diversity. |
| `{col}_lag7` | float64 | Value of `{col}` 7 days prior. |
| `{col}_roll7` | float64 | 7-day trailing rolling mean of `{col}`. |
| `{col}_roll14` | float64 | 14-day trailing rolling mean of `{col}`. |

### Load snippet

```python
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_parquet("data/processed/features_daily.parquet")
df = df.drop(columns=["index"], errors="ignore")

feature_cols = [c for c in df.columns if c not in ["node_id", "date"]]
df[feature_cols] = df[feature_cols].astype("float32")
```

> **Note:** `n_articles`, `conflict_events`, and `unrest_events` are stored as
> nullable `Int64`. Cast to `float32` before passing to PyTorch.

Run `python -m data.validate` to reproduce the validation plot.

## Labels

**File:** `data/processed/labels_daily.parquet`  
**Generated by:** `data/acled_labels.py`  
**Source:** ACLED — Mali, Niger, Burkina Faso, Chad, Mauritania, 2018–2024

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Shape | 63,925 rows × 5 columns (25 nodes × 2,557 days) |
| Date range | 2018-01-01 → 2024-12-31 |
| Missing days | Filled with **0** |

### Columns

| Column | dtype | Description |
|--------|-------|-------------|
| `node_id` | str | City identifier |
| `date` | datetime64 | Calendar date |
| `y_conflict` | int8 | 1 if Battles / Explosions / Violence against civilians within 80km |
| `y_unrest` | int8 | 1 if Protests / Riots / Strategic developments within 80km |
| `fatalities` | int32 | Sum of ACLED fatalities for the node on that day |

### Class balance

| Target | Approx. positive rate |
|--------|-----------------------|
| `y_conflict` | ~9% (higher in Burkina Faso, Mali) |
| `y_unrest` | ~7% (higher in Mauritania, Niger) |

Run `python -m data.validate_labels` for per-country breakdown.

## Training Dataset

**File:** `data/processed/dataset_daily.parquet`  
**Generated by:** `data/build_dataset.py`  
**Description:** Inner join of features and labels — the unified file used for model training.

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Shape | 45,675 rows × 29 columns |
| Date range | 2020-01-01 → 2024-12-31 |
| Nulls | 0 |

All feature columns from `features_daily.parquet` plus `y_conflict`, `y_unrest`,
and `fatalities`.

### Load snippet

```python
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_parquet("data/processed/dataset_daily.parquet")
feature_cols = [c for c in df.columns
                if c not in ["node_id", "date", "y_conflict", "y_unrest", "fatalities"]]
df[feature_cols] = df[feature_cols].astype("float32")
```

---

## Walk-Forward Validation Splits

**Defined in:** `evaluation/splits.py`

We use expanding-window cross-validation to prevent data leakage. Random
train/test splits are not appropriate for time-series conflict data.

| Split | Train | Validation |
|-------|-------|------------|
| 1 | 2020-01-01 → 2021-12-31 | 2022 |
| 2 | 2020-01-01 → 2022-12-31 | 2023 |
| 3 | 2020-01-01 → 2023-12-31 | 2024 |

```python
from evaluation.splits import get_split_data, get_node_order

df_train, df_val = get_split_data(df, split=1)
node_order = get_node_order()  # canonical 25-node list for aligning X with adjacency matrix
```

---

## Niger coverage note

Niger events are queried using both `NI` and `NE` country codes to handle GDELT's
ambiguous ISO mapping. Niamey, Agadez, Tahoua, and Tillaberi use a 120 km
assignment radius instead of the default 80 km due to GDELT's regional geocoding
patterns for remote Sahel cities.

Agadez has zero GDELT event coverage even at 120 km — a genuine data gap.
The node relies on neighbor signal propagation through the graph.
